intro.text: An ancient poem of Sel, three thousand lines long, about Fjorden's founder, the first Wyrn. It is believed to be Sel's earliest known literary work, predating the Do-Kando.

description.text: Altered versions of the poem portray Wyrn as a Derethi and refer again and again to the importance of Jaddeth.

items.text: In Elantris, Sarene found the unaltered poem in a copy of Seor's Encyclopedia of Political Myths, a book that debunked much of the Derethi church's propaganda, citing the altered poem among its examples. In the original, Shu-Dereth goes unmentioned, and Jaddeth is only a minor god of the rocks beneath the ground.
Sarene noted that Fjorden's priests would be badly embarrassed if their tampering became known.
